advanced.title: APIs & Sensors (Step 2/2)
advanced.description:
Configure APIs, Temperature, and Lights.

💡 **Note:** All fields on this page are completely **optional**, but highly recommended for the best experience. Leave blank if you don't use them.

data_description.spotify_client_id: Highly recommended for 100% accurate album art. [Get your free key here](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard).
data_description.tidal_client_id: Required only if you stream via Tidal. [Get your free key here](https://developer.tidal.com/).
data_description.lastfm_key: Backup source for album covers. [Get your free key here](https://www.last.fm/api/account/create).
data_description.discogs_token: Backup source for album covers. [Get your free key here](https://www.discogs.com/settings/developers).
data_description.pollinations_key: Generates AI conceptual art if no cover is found. [Get a free key here](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
data_description.light_entity: Select one or more RGB lights to automatically sync with the album cover's dominant colors.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Pixoo64. Please check the IP address.
